description: This file defines the UpdateCompilerPass class implementing a Symfony DependencyInjection compiler pass for removing services with unmet dependencies in Drupal.

classes.name: UpdateCompilerPass
classes.description: Implements a Symfony compiler pass to remove services with unmet dependencies during container compilation.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that iterates over service definitions and removes those with missing dependencies, also cleans up related aliases.

methods.name: isArgumentMissingService
methods.description: Checks if a given argument references a missing service that is required, based on the container's state and reference behavior.
